title: Harmon label registry
$comment: Machine-readable label taxonomy. One family per axis, each naming who may write it (writers), how long a value lives (lifecycle), and where its values come from (source). setup-github-labels.sh and status.sh read the RENDERED form (scripts/label-registry-labels.mjs); the triage skill and track-work's metadata checker read this file directly. Structural rules only — the either/or rules between source, values, and registry live in scripts/validate-label-registry.mjs, which reports them by name. There is deliberately no `type:*` family: that prefix is foreman's conventional-commit override, so work type lives in native issue Type on org repos and in the work-type family here.

prefix.$comment: null means the family's values are bare label names (`sec`, `blocked`). A string is joined to each value with a colon (`layer` + `ui` -> `layer:ui`).

labelName.$comment: A value's own name. Spaces are permitted because tool-owned labels have them (release-please ships `autorelease: pending`); 50 is GitHub's cap on a label name, and the validator re-checks it AFTER the prefix is joined on.

color.$comment: Six uppercase hex digits, no leading `#` — the form `gh label create --color` takes. GitHub treats hex as case-insensitive; uppercase is this repo's convention so the manifest and the renderer compare byte-for-byte.

description.$comment: GitHub caps label descriptions at 100 characters and rejects the whole label past it (harmon-init#680). agent-registry.schema.json carries the same cap on the display_name it renders descriptions from.

axis.$comment: The question the family answers. Two families may share an axis (`suggest`/`claim` are both `model`); `exclusive` is what limits an axis to one label per issue.

writer.$comment: `trusted-human` marks a value an actor-verifying consumer additionally authenticates (foreman's arming inputs). The label itself still carries no permission — the class names which consumer-side check applies. `tool:<name>` is a label its owning tool creates and moves.

registry.$comment: Composes values from agent-registry.json instead of (or alongside) an inline list, so the two manifests cannot fork. The renderer spawns scripts/agent-registry-labels.mjs in this mode and keeps the lines matching the family prefix.

source.$comment: Both values mean the same two things: documented here, never provisioned, never deleted. They differ in who does create the label — its owning tool on demand (`tool-owned`), or GitHub when it seeds a new repository (`github-default`). A github-default value carries no color or description because GitHub's own are authoritative and this manifest must not restate them.

exclusive.$comment: true means at most one label of this family per issue. Advisory axes are false even where they resolve strongest-wins, because two labels are a legal state a consumer has to resolve rather than a taxonomy violation.
